<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
  
  <!-- Blue header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="224" fill="#4658E0"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="18" y="17" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <rect x="340" y="9" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <rect x="346" y="7" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <rect x="352" y="5" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="12" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <path d="M319 10 Q326 3 333 10" fill="none" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="6" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="364" y="8" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <rect x="383" y="9" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Header toolbar -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="29,52 21,60 29,68" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="44" y="65" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Puntos calificables</text>
    <circle cx="356" cy="60" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="54" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="356" cy="64" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Points summary -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="99" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Tu saldo de puntos calificables</text>
    <text x="24" y="145" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="45px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="-1.8px" fill="#FFFFFF">0</text>
    <text x="57" y="143" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="18px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">de 12.000 puntos</text>
    <text x="24" y="174" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Acumulados durante el año calendario</text>
    
    <!-- Year selector -->
    <rect x="270" y="113" width="96" height="48" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="284" y="133" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Año</text>
    <text x="284" y="151" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">2025</text>
    <polyline points="348,132 353,137 358,132" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Informational banner -->
  <g>
    <rect x="13" y="198" width="364" height="111" rx="7" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="13" y="196" width="364" height="111" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="37" cy="222" r="9" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <text x="37" y="227" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="56" y="222" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">¿Cómo funcionan tus puntos?</text>
    <text x="27" y="247" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">Suma puntos calificables al viajar con</text>
    <text x="27" y="267" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">nosotros y alcanza nuevas categorías.</text>
    <text x="27" y="289" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Conoce más sobre el programa</text>
    <polyline points="349,284 354,289 349,294" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- History heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="348" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Historial de puntos</text>
    <text x="18" y="371" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Movimientos de 2025</text>
    <rect x="294" y="333" width="80" height="32" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <text x="307" y="354" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Filtrar</text>
    <line x1="18" y1="386" x2="372" y2="386" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Empty state card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="402" width="362" height="284" rx="14" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.65"/>
    <rect x="14" y="400" width="362" height="284" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- Cactus illustration, seven paths -->
    <g transform="translate(151 423)">
      <path d="M43 102 L43 37 Q43 23 55 23 Q67 23 67 37 L67 52 Q67 58 73 58 Q79 58 79 52 L79 43" fill="none" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M43 71 Q43 63 35 63 Q27 63 27 71 L27 82" fill="none" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M43 98 Q49 104 57 104 Q65 104 70 98" fill="none" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M14 105 Q49 96 91 105" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M5 111 Q51 105 99 111" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M26 20 Q42 8 57 14" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M76 16 L82 8 L87 16 L96 18 L88 23 L89 32 L81 27 L73 32 L74 23 L66 18 Z" fill="#EA104C" stroke="none"/>
    </g>
    
    <text x="195" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Todavía no tienes movimientos</text>
    <text x="195" y="592" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuando sumes puntos, aparecerán</text>
    <text x="195" y="612" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">aquí junto con la fecha y el detalle.</text>
    
    <g>
      <rect x="76" y="633" width="238" height="39" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA104C"/>
      <text x="195" y="658" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Descubre cómo sumar puntos</text>
    </g>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#E0E0E2"/>
    
    <!-- Inicio -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,793 49,785 59,793 59,805 39,805" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <polyline points="35,793 49,781 63,793" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="49" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Viajes -->
    <g>
      <rect x="116" y="785" width="22" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="120" y1="790" x2="134" y2="790" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <polyline points="121,785 124,781 131,781 134,785" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="127" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Viajes</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Puntos selected -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="205" cy="793" r="15" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
      <polygon points="205,781 208,789 217,789 210,794 212,802 205,797 198,802 200,794 193,789 202,789" fill="#4658E0"/>
      <text x="205" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#4658E0">Puntos</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Ayuda -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="282" cy="793" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="282" y="798" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">?</text>
      <text x="282" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Ayuda</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Perfil -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="349" cy="788" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="349" cy="801" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="349" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Perfil</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
